periods.name: nginx access log flush

periods.name: hyptcn-lab-udrzba.timer

periods.name: worker loop
periods.journal_line: the worker's line {"service": "worker", "completed": n} (lab/services.py worker): only a round that completed orders prints one, so a round lasts at most the smallest spacings

periods.name: HTTP server poll
periods.why: socketserver's poll timeout runs inside the services and logs nothing

periods.name: event stop health wait
periods.why: runs in labctl event stop; its output goes back to the host (events.json), not into the journal

periods.name: log segment reopen wait
periods.why: runs in labctl segment between runs; its output goes back to the host

periods.name: deployment health wait
periods.why: runs in lab/install.sh under labctl deploy; its output is the deploy step's (labctl_deploy.stdout)
